description: Prepared, unapplied OpenBao Kubernetes-auth role configuration for seam-retirement-evaluator. This is a historical draft, not the policy in force: the deployed policy is declarative-config k8s/rs-manager/seam-retirement-evaluator/openbao-policy.hcl (commit eec9f2f3, 2026-09-04), which grants read on exact credential paths and denies BOTH the consolidated and the legacy SEAM route prefixes. Path shape here (evaluators/... prefix grants, single legacy route deny) predates the secret/seam/* to secret/rs-manager/rs-manager/seam/* consolidation.

denied_paths.purpose: Prevent access to SEAM route credentials at the consolidated prefix now in force. This deny is present in the deployed policy (declarative-config k8s/rs-manager/seam-retirement-evaluator/openbao-policy.hcl, commit eec9f2f3) but was absent from this prepared draft.

LEGACY / RETIRED base. Kept only because the deployed policy carries both denies until the legacy paths retire. SEAM's enforced vault base dir is rs-manager/rs-manager/seam/routes; a bare seam/routes path no longer validates.
Default deny for unrelated KV data.

cli.role_write: bao write auth/kubernetes/role/seam-retirement-evaluator bound_service_account_names=seam-retirement-evaluator bound_service_account_namespaces=seam policies=seam-retirement-evaluator-policy token_default_policies=seam-retirement-evaluator-policy token_ttl=24h token_max_ttl=72h token_type=default token_num_uses=0

prerequisites: The kubernetes auth mount must be enabled at auth/kubernetes.
ServiceAccount seam-retirement-evaluator must exist in namespace seam.
An authorized OpenBao operator must apply the policy before the role is used.
No OpenBao writes are performed by this artifact.
